fabricationFlags: Program metadata systematically wrong: nearly all MS/MArch/MUD/MFT programs are tagged level="bachelor" (e.g. 'MS User Experience and Interaction Design' level=bachelor durationYears=3; 'DNP - Clinical Practice' level=master).

durationYears is uniform filler: every program is either 3 or 1 regardless of reality (Bachelor of Architecture is a 5-year BArch shown as 3; one-year graduate certificates shown as 3; MD/PhD shown as 3).
keyFactsRu contradicts payload: claims '1 программа' and 'Программы: бакалавриат' while the programs array contains ~57 entries across bachelor/master/phd/short-course.
intakes uniformly 'September' for every program (filler, not per-program verification).
Lead program sourced from aggregator edvoy (edge.edvoy.com), not the official site; confidence=aggregator.
description states '242 international students' and '63% acceptance rate' as precise figures with no source - unverifiable specific claims.
tuition.byProgram is empty {} yet tuition.currency=USD is set, implying pricing data that does not exist.
evidence: Official site jefferson.edu confirmed (200). College of Architecture & the Built Environment programs page confirms BArch, BS Architectural Studies, BS Construction Management, BS Interior Design, BLA, MArch, MS Arch & Design Research, MS Construction Mgmt, MS Historic Preservation, MS Real Estate Development, MS Sustainable Design, Urban Analytics & Geodesign - so the program TITLES and programUrls are largely real, but level/durationYears fields are wrong. Tuition (official cost-of-attendance + research.com/US News): UG full-time tuition ~$44,400, fees ~$1,133, 2026 est. tuition+fees ~$49,250; graduate full-time ~$23,202; total COA w/ room&board ~$65,637. Catalog tuition object is empty -> absent. Scholarships: official + aggregators confirm merit scholarships $4,000-$19,000, 90% of UG receive aid, avg aid $27,176 - catalog has no scholarships field -> absent. Campuses: official confirms East Falls Campus AND Center City Campus (13-acre shared with Jefferson Hospital); catalog lists only East Falls -> stale/incomplete. Accommodation: official East Falls Residential Life confirms 1,600+ on-campus beds (Fortess, Mott, Partridge, Ronson, Scholler Hall, Independence Plaza, townhouses); catalog has no accommodation data -> absent.
